text:
olivia: Heads-up: starting deploy window for embeddings-service v3.14 -> v3.15. Initial ramp to 10% (canary).
deploy-bot: Preflight checks green. Observability hooks: kv-cache, p95, 5xx, pod-restarts. dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/sessions/1768209999
maria: watching p95 and 5xx. will call if >1.5% 5xx or p95 > 350ms
kevin: quick note: v3.15 includes new quantize kernel; memory-wise it's been fine in staging
sanjay: eu-west routing to embed-12 for canary traffic. i'll tail logs
maria: small p95 drift in eu-west: 120ms -> 210ms but 5xx still 0.1%
kevin: now seeing bursts of 502 from embed-12, about 7 in last 3m
ops-bot: Alert: rolling-embed: 5xx spike 1.8% at 2026-06-10T14:18:40Z 1:traffic-hold policy triggered
olivia: hold any further ramp. pin traffic for eu-west to v3.14. Mark rollout PAUSED. Add to release notes.
maria: query:`SELECT status, count(*) FROM http_logs WHERE route='/v1/embeddings' AND region='eu-west' AND ts > now()-10m GROUP BY status;` results: 502 x 21, 200 x 920
sanjay: ssh'ed into embed-12: `journalctl -u embed-worker` shows OOM at ~14:16 then restart.
kevin: looks like quantize kernel update increased peak RSS on that host. embedding-worker restarted twice
olivia: decision: PAUSE rollout and rollback runtime on embed-12 to 2.9. pin region to v3.14 until infra confirms memory profile. create incident and tasks.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused. Traffic pinned to v3.14 in eu-west. Created INC-5123 (rollback embed-12), TASK-7284 (postmortem owner: sanjay). Healthcheck scheduled in 5m.
sanjay: initiating rollback now. will report when instance back to stable
maria: will monitor p95 and 5xx across regions, posting updates here
ops-bot: Follow-up healthcheck: p95 eu-west dropped from 260ms -> 140ms, 5xx from 1.9% -> 0.15% at 2026-06-10T14:27:30Z
kevin: rollback confirmed done on embed-12, no further restarts in logs
olivia: thanks. leaving rollout paused until infra gives all-clear. drafting release-note: "Paused v3.15 canary due to eu-west 502s/oom; rollback applied to embed-12; monitoring ongoing." :memo:
maria: will add perf traces to TASK-7284 for deeper analysis
sanjay: standing by for infra follow-up and scheduling wider rollback if other hosts show similar behaviour
olivia: if metrics don't normalize by next healthcheck (10m) we'll escalate. otherwise keep documentation and changelog updated.
